About this video

Created by Maths by Zosiama. Question 1: If A and B are two sets such that n(A) = 17, n(B) = 23 and n(A∪B) = 38, find n(A∩B). Answer: n(A∩B) = 2 elements.

Every frame is drawn in code on one canvas as a pure function of time (60 fps). No video models, stock footage, photos or AI images. Narration: Kokoro-82M voice (Apache-2.0), generated offline. Music and sound effects: synthesised in code. Fonts: Fredoka and Noto Sans Devanagari (SIL OFL 1.1), DejaVu Sans symbol subset (Bitstream Vera licence).
